mechanism: DTI is max-cover based: TP_w uses the best dot per truth pixel, while FP_w charges every dot its unclaimed mass. A dot that is not the unique max-cover for any truth pixel can be removed without losing TP_w, so removal raises DTI. The 0.2778 pair differs only by 2,545 dots that all lie 1.41-2.00 px from the known catalogue.
